snippet.title: Sibilla (Tech demo) • A new 2026 real PlayStation 1 Game • Demo full playthrough v0.1.3
snippet.description:
Hi! This is a full playthrough of Sibilla, my new game in development for the first PlayStation.
This is an early tech demo and it's running on real hardware, my PSX PAL SCPH-7502. 

I released this demo to participate to the 2026 Low Poly Day on Newgrounds.

Unfortunately my capture card had some difficulties capturing the game. Sorry for the issues with the audio and the very dark video.

You can find more about this demo here 
https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/1035766

The CHD file is available for free on my website. BIN/CUE will be available soon
https://www.pasquiindustry.com/sibillademo/

I made this game with PsxSplash / Splashedit
https://psxsplash.github.io/
